subject: Order form: staggered evidence windows and pen-test fallback plan
messages:
From: Aisha Kumar <aisha.kumar@zenithhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Carl Perez <carl.perez@zenithhealth.com>, infosec@zenithhealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form draft + security exhibit questions

Diego / Laura —

Thanks for sending the order form draft this morning. Our InfoSec team reviewed the security exhibit and asked for two clarifications before procurement can approve:

1) Evidence windowing: they want a proposal that avoids single-day, high-intensity evidence pushes. Can Redwood propose a staggered 2-week window cadence (split by environment and artifact type) so we can staff reviewers?

2) Pen test access: Zenith requires ephemeral credentials and a defined blast-radius for external pen testers. We also need a fallback path if a pen test timing collides with a production maintenance window.

Attached are our initial internal asks (high level). Can you send a short ops/playbook that maps each request to owner and timing? Procurement also wants to see the redlined order form and any SOW language that limits inspection to SOC 2 artifacts only.

Proposed quick sync: Thu 23 Sep 11a PT — can you and someone from legal join?

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Kumar
Senior Security Program Manager
Zenith Health

Attachment: zenith-internal-asks-summary.pdf

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Kumar <aisha.kumar@zenithhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, Carl Perez <carl.perez@zenithhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form draft + security exhibit questions

Aisha —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick replies inline, then a proposed plan below.

1) Staggered evidence windows: agreeable. We'll propose a quarterly cadence with overlapping 2-week windows separated by artifact type (logs/configs; SOC2 artifacts; operational runbooks). This reduces peak review load and lets Zenith nominate reviewers per window.

2) Pen test ops & fallback: Redwood can provide ephemeral, time-boxed credentials and an isolated staging instance for external tests. For production-simulated tests we require a minimum 72-hour blackout notice; if a maintenance window conflicts, we provide a rolling fallback window within the same quarterly cycle. We'll document blast-radius limitations and a kill-switch procedure for any test that causes systemic impact.

Planned deliverables before Thu sync:
- Evidence matrix (attachment): owners, expected artifact samples, retentions, and proposed 2-week windows per quarter.
- Pen-test ops proposal (attachment): ephemeral creds, staging vs prod gating, rollback/kill-switch checklist.
- Redlined order form (attachment): we limited the inspection clause to scoped exhibits (SOC2, pen-test reports) and added language about advance notice and scheduling conflicts.

I'll loop in Marissa from Legal to confirm the redlines are acceptable from an MSA/order-form standpoint.

If Thu 23 11a PT works for you, I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-evidence-matrix-v1.xlsx; pen-test-ops-proposal.pdf; orderform-draft-redlines.docx

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Kumar <aisha.kumar@zenithhealth.com>, diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Carl Perez <carl.perez@zenithhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form draft + security exhibit questions

Aisha/Diego/Carl —

Thanks for the heads-up. Two legal notes to flag before the call:

• Scoped inspection language: instead of an open "audit rights" clause, we've proposed a scoped exhibit that enumerates the types of evidence Zenith can request (SOC 2 reports, specific log slices, pen-test summaries). We added an acceptance criteria table so requests are not treated as ad-hoc discovery.

• Pen-test liability carveout: Redwood will permit customer-directed pen tests against a staging replica. For any test against a production environment (rare), we require a signed SOW addendum that defines test loft, data handling, remediation SLAs, and insurance confirmation. That gives both parties an explicit escalation and cost boundary.

On the evidence windows: operationally, please confirm whether Zenith prefers reviewer rotations (we provide 2 reviewer slots per window) or a single named reviewer for the quarter. We can support either but the SLOs differ.

I'll be on the Thu 23 call.

–Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Order form draft + security exhibit questions — sync notes and next steps

Aisha/Carl/InfoSec —

Thanks for the call this morning — useful alignment. Summary and next steps below: 

Summary (decisions made)
- Evidence cadence: agreed to quarterly cycles with overlapping 2-week windows; Zenith will provide primary reviewer names per quarter.
- Pen test: remote staging for all external tests; production tests allowed only with signed SOW addendum and 14-day advanced notice. Ephemeral creds and kill-switch procedure agreed.
- Scoped inspection: Redwood's redlined exhibit accepted in principle; legal to finalize minor language on "reasonable scope" fallback.

Action items
- Diego: upload final evidence matrix (v1 -> v1.1) with discrete sample requests by EOD Fri 24 Sep. (Attachment link below)
- Laura/Marissa: finalize the order-form redline and SOW addendum text; target internal sign-off by Tue 28 Sep.
- Aisha: share list of preferred reviewer names and any blackout weeks for Q4 by Mon 27 Sep.

Attachments uploaded: redwood-evidence-matrix-v1.1.xlsx (contains the split 2-week windows and review owner columns).

Related links:
- Evidence matrix: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cExampleEvidenceMatrix
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/67890

If anything above looks off, reply-all and I'll update the matrix. Otherwise we'll move into the redline sign-off path.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
